### 📄 `src\audioengine\ISRLifecycle.h`

```
#pragma once

#include <atomic>
#include <mutex>
#include <cstdint>
#include <filesystem>
#include <array>

namespace convo {
namespace isr {

/**
 * ISR 10層 Architecture Layer 0: Lifecycle Isolation Runtime
 * JUCE callback の非決定性を runtime invariant に変換する。
 */

enum class LifecyclePhase
{
    Uninitialized,  // 初期状態
    Preparing,      // prepareToPlay 実行中
    Prepared,       // audioCallback 受付可能
    AudioRunning,   // audioCallback 実行中（re-entrant 禁止）
    Releasing,      // releaseResources 実行中
    Released,       // リソース解放完了
    Shutdown        // 終端（再 prepare 禁止）
};

/**
 * callback 入口での epoch トークン
 */
struct LifecycleToken
{
    uint64_t epochId;
    LifecyclePhase expectedPhase;
};

/**
 * RT callback 内での stack-local epoch 識別子
 */
struct CallbackExecutionEpoch
{
    uint64_t lifecycleEpoch;
    uint64_t sampleCursor;
};

/**
 * LifecyclePhase ステートマシン runtime
 * JUCE callback の違反（overlap, late callback, etc.）を検出・abort する。
 *
 * 受入条件（LIF-1～LIF-6）:
 *  - LIF-1: prepareToPlay serialized
 *  - LIF-2: releaseResources は AudioRunning 中に呼べない
 *  - LIF-3: Releasing phase 中の publish 禁止
 *  - LIF-4: crossfade start は Prepared 以降のみ
 *  - LIF-5: callback 中 runtimeVersion 変化なし
 *  - LIF-6: callback 中 DSP generation 変化なし
 */
class LifecycleIsolationRuntime
{
public:
    LifecycleIsolationRuntime();
    ~LifecycleIsolationRuntime();

    // NonRT: prepareToPlay 入口
    LifecycleToken enterPrepare(int sampleRate, int blockSize);
    void leavePrepare(LifecycleToken token);

    // RT: audioCallback 入口
    LifecycleToken enterAudioCallback();
    void leaveAudioCallback(LifecycleToken token);

    // NonRT: releaseResources 入口
    LifecycleToken enterRelease();
    void leaveRelease(LifecycleToken token);

    // 終端
    void shutdown();

    // 現在 phase（RT safe: atomic read）
    LifecyclePhase current() const noexcept;

    // phase が AudioRunning であることを assert（RT callable）
    void assertAudioRunning() const noexcept;

    // artifact emit（shutdown time または CI trigger）
    void emitPhaseTrace(const std::filesystem::path& outputPath);

private:
    struct PhaseTransition
    {
        LifecyclePhase from;
        LifecyclePhase to;
        uint64_t epochId;
        uint64_t timestamp_ns;
    };

    void validateTransition(LifecyclePhase from, LifecyclePhase to);
    LifecyclePhase transitionTo(LifecyclePhase next);

    std::atomic<LifecyclePhase> phase_{ LifecyclePhase::Uninitialized };
    std::atomic<uint64_t> epochCounter_{ 0 };
    std::atomic<uint32_t> hostChaosViolations_{ 0 };
    std::atomic<uint32_t> duplicatePrepareCollapsed_{ 0 };
    std::atomic<int> lastPreparedSampleRate_{ 0 };
    std::atomic<int> lastPreparedBlockSize_{ 0 };
    std::mutex nonRtGuard_;

    // artifact 用 trace buffer（ロックフリーリングバッファ）
    static constexpr size_t kTraceBufferSize = 4096;
    std::array<PhaseTransition, kTraceBufferSize> traceBuffer_{};
    std::atomic<size_t> traceWriteIndex_{0};
    std::atomic<bool> traceFull_{false};
};

/**
 * LifecyclePhase transition に HB edge を付与する
 */
class LifecycleBarrierRuntime
{
public:
    LifecycleBarrierRuntime(LifecycleIsolationRuntime& lifecycleRuntime);

    // prepareToPlay 完了後、Prepared HB edge を emit
    void publishPreparedBarrier();

    // releaseResources 開始前、AudioStopped HB edge を emit
    void publishReleasingBarrier();

    // shutdown 完了後、Shutdown HB edge を emit
    void publishShutdownBarrier();

private:
    LifecycleIsolationRuntime& lifecycleRuntime_;
};

} // namespace isr
} // namespace convo

```

```
#pragma once

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// ISRLifetimeProof.h — Shutdown lifetime proof / permit types (dash2 §2.2 / H.11)
//
// ★ REPAIR_PLAN2-dash2.md 実装: Phase A1（H.11.17.5 15-Step 1-6, type only）
//   Step 1: ShutdownRuntimeIdentity
//   Step 2: ShutdownQuiescenceProof（Q0〜Q7 — H.11.11.3）
//   Step 3: ReclaimPermit（move-only / single-use / identity-bound — H.11.11.9.5）
//   Step 6: ReclaimIdentity（DSPHandle + retireSequence — H.11.11.9.5）
//
// ★ 接続状況（実装が正）: Phase A2（15-Step 7-15）で production の shutdown reclaim
//   経路へ接続済み。呼出チェーンは
//     AudioEngine::tryShutdownQuiescentReclaim（AudioEngine.h）
//       → ShutdownRuntime::tryMakeQuiescenceProof / tryMakeReclaimPermit（ISRShutdown.cpp）
//       → RuntimeIntentCoordinator::reclaimShutdownQuiescent（identity 照合 + permit.consume）
//   であり、~AudioEngine → releaseResources() から到達する。
//   ReclaimPermit の生成は ShutdownRuntime のみ（friend / AC-X3-11 / INV-LIFE-4）。
//
// ★ 不変条件（H.11.11.7 INV-LIFE）:
//   INV-LIFE-3: ShutdownQuiescenceProof は ShutdownRuntime のみ生成可能
//   INV-LIFE-4: ReclaimPermit は ShutdownRuntime の shutdown transaction からのみ生成可能
//   INV-LIFE-5: Proof.identity == Permit.identity
//   INV-LIFE-6: Permit.identity == current shutdown transaction identity
//   INV-LIFE-7: Permit は一度しか consume できない
//   INV-LIFE-8: Proof 生成後、lifetime obligation を生成する API はすべて reject
//   INV-LIFE-9: Closed → Open は存在しない（no-resurrection）
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

#include <atomic>
#include <cstdint>
#include <optional>
#include <utility>

#include "ISRDSPHandle.h"   // ReclaimIdentity::handle（DSPHandle）

namespace convo {
namespace isr {

// ShutdownRuntime の前方宣言（friend 宣言用。完全定義は ISRShutdown.h）
class ShutdownRuntime;

// ── Step 1: ShutdownRuntimeIdentity ─────────────────────────────────────────
//   shutdown transaction を識別する immutable identity。
//   - engineInstanceId: Runtime インスタンスを一意に識別（cross-runtime confusion 防止 — AUTH-09/13）。
//     Runtime A / Shutdown N と Runtime B / Shutdown N が同一 generation（例: 1）でも、
//     engineInstanceId で区別する（Permit の cross-runtime injection を構造的に防止）。
//   - generation: Shutdown N を一意に識別（Permit ABA 防止 — T10 / Race B）
//   - epochGeneration / readerRegistrationGeneration: Epoch / reader registration の
//     generation を束縛し、Shutdown N の Permit を Shutdown N+1 で使えないようにする
//     （第三者的レビュー反映 3 — permit identity を ShutdownRuntime に束縛）。
struct ShutdownRuntimeIdentity {
    std::uint64_t engineInstanceId{0};                 // Runtime インスタンス一意 ID（AUTH-09/13）
    std::uint64_t generation{0};                       // シャットダウン回数（単調増加）
    std::uint64_t epochGeneration{0};                  // EpochDomain の generation
    std::uint64_t readerRegistrationGeneration{0};     // Reader registration の generation

    [[nodiscard]] bool operator==(const ShutdownRuntimeIdentity& o) const noexcept = default;
    [[nodiscard]] bool isNull() const noexcept { return engineInstanceId == 0 && generation == 0; }
};

// ── Step 6: ReclaimIdentity ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
//   reclaim obligation の identity（H.11.11.9.5）。
//   pendingReclaimHandles_（std::vector<DSPHandle>）を本 identity set へ昇格する際の要素。
//   retireSequence は deterministic ordering（INV-FIFO-1 secondary — memory safety には使わない）。
//   ★ NonRT ReclaimAuthority 専用（第七者 #12 — Audio Thread からは呼ばない / AC-ISR-1）。
struct ReclaimIdentity {
    DSPHandle   handle;            // reclaim 対象 DSPHandle
    std::uint64_t retireSequence{0}; // deterministic ordering（INV-FIFO-1）

    [[nodiscard]] bool operator==(const ReclaimIdentity& o) const noexcept = default;
};

// ── Step 5: EpochQuiescenceEvidence（H.11.13.3 / Q5） ───────────────────────
//   Q5 EpochSettled を「generation 値」や caller の bool 単独で成立させないための
//   transactional evidence。epoch の前進・reader 登録の閉鎖・active reader ゼロを
//   同一の観測点で取得し、ShutdownRuntime が identity（epochGeneration /
//   readerRegistrationGeneration）と照合して初めて Q5 を成立させる。
//   ［observer は AudioEngine（EpochDomain / ISRRetireRouter の所有者）。
//     検証と Proof への格納は ShutdownRuntime の責務（authority singularization）］
//   ［第七者 C: generation 単独では quiescence を証明できない。quiescent() を必ず要求する］
struct EpochQuiescenceEvidence {
    bool          captured{false};                    // 観測を実施したか（false = 未取得 → Q5 不成立）
    std::uint64_t epoch{0};                           // EpochDomain::currentEpoch()
    std::uint64_t epochGeneration{0};                 // EpochDomain::epochGeneration()
    std::uint64_t readerRegistrationGeneration{0};    // EpochDomain::readerRegistrationGeneration()
    bool          readerRegistrationClosed{false};    // EpochDomain::readerRegistrationClosed()
    std::uint32_t activeReaders{0};                   // ISRRetireRouter::activeReaderCount()
    std::uint64_t minReaderEpoch{0};                  // ISRRetireRouter::minReaderEpoch()

    // quiescence の実体（登録閉鎖 + active reader ゼロ）。generation 一致は呼出側で照合する。
    [[nodiscard]] bool quiescent() const noexcept
    {
        return captured && readerRegistrationClosed && activeReaders == 0;
    }
};

// ── Step 2: ShutdownQuiescenceProof ─────────────────────────────────────────
//   「これ以降、新しい lifetime obligation が発生しない」ことの証明（Q0〜Q7, H.11.11.3）。
//   ⚠️ 循環排除（第五者レビュー）: pendingReclaimIdentities.empty() と
//   LifetimeAccounting.isDrained() は Proof 条件に含めない（ShutdownCompletionProof 側 / C1/C2）。
//   Q0〜Q7 は「quiescence（新 obligation なし）」の証明であり、completion（全消滅）ではない。
//   ［immutable — 生成は ShutdownRuntime::tryMakeQuiescenceProof() のみ（INV-LIFE-3）］
class ShutdownQuiescenceProof {
public:
    ShutdownQuiescenceProof(const ShutdownQuiescenceProof&) = delete;
    ShutdownQuiescenceProof& operator=(const ShutdownQuiescenceProof&) = delete;
    ShutdownQuiescenceProof(ShutdownQuiescenceProof&&) noexcept = default;
    ShutdownQuiescenceProof& operator=(ShutdownQuiescenceProof&&) noexcept = default;

    // Q0〜Q7 全条件が成立した場合のみ生成される（valid() == true）。
    [[nodiscard]] bool valid() const noexcept { return valid_; }

    [[nodiscard]] const ShutdownRuntimeIdentity& identity() const noexcept { return identity_; }

    // Q 条件別の観測結果（監査・診断用。Proof の成否は valid_ で判定）
    [[nodiscard]] bool admissionReservationsZero() const noexcept { return qAdmissionReservationsZero_; }
    [[nodiscard]] bool admissionClosed() const noexcept { return qAdmissionClosed_; }
    [[nodiscard]] bool allProducersJoined() const noexcept { return qAllProducersJoined_; }
    [[nodiscard]] bool readerRegistrationClosed() const noexcept { return qReaderRegClosed_; }
    [[nodiscard]] bool activeReadersZero() const noexcept { return qActiveReadersZero_; }
    [[nodiscard]] bool epochSettled() const noexcept { return qEpochSettled_; }
    [[nodiscard]] bool postStopEnqueueZero() const noexcept { return qPostStopEnqueueZero_; }
    [[nodiscard]] bool noResurrection() const noexcept { return qNoResurrection_; }
    // Q5 の根拠（quiescence 時に取得した epoch / reader 観測）。Proof の事後監査に使う。
    [[nodiscard]] const EpochQuiescenceEvidence& epochEvidence() const noexcept { return epochEvidence_; }

private:
    // 生成は ShutdownRuntime のみ（INV-LIFE-3 / AC-X3-11）。簡易生成（if (isFullyDrained()) return ...）
    // を防止（A2-G05 — 全条件を authority から取得して検証するのは tryMakeQuiescenceProof 側の責務）。
    friend class ShutdownRuntime;

    explicit ShutdownQuiescenceProof(ShutdownRuntimeIdentity id) noexcept
        : identity_(id) {}

    ShutdownRuntimeIdentity identity_;

    bool valid_{false};
    bool qAdmissionReservationsZero_{false};   // Q0
    bool qAdmissionClosed_{false};             // Q1
    bool qAllProducersJoined_{false};          // Q2
    bool qReaderRegClosed_{false};             // Q3
    bool qActiveReadersZero_{false};           // Q4
    bool qEpochSettled_{false};                // Q5（epochEvidence_ の検証結果）
    bool qPostStopEnqueueZero_{false};         // Q6
    bool qNoResurrection_{false};              // Q7
    EpochQuiescenceEvidence epochEvidence_{};  // Q5 の根拠（事後監査用）
};

// ── Step 3: ReclaimPermit ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
//   shutdown transaction の reclaim phase への参加権（H.11.11.9.5）。
//   - move-only（コピー禁止）: 二重 reclaim（reclaim(permit); reclaim(permit);）を構造的防止
//   - single-use: consume() で Consumed state へ原子遷移（INV-LIFE-7 / T9 concurrent double reclaim）
//   - identity-bound: Proof.identity と一致する shutdown transaction でのみ有効（INV-LIFE-5/6 / T10 ABA）
//   - 万能 token ではない: Permit 自体が delete DSPCore を許可するのではなく、
//     ShutdownQuiescent ReclaimAuthority の起動権（第九者 #8 / H.11.11.9.5）。
class ReclaimPermit {
public:
    ReclaimPermit(const ReclaimPermit&) = delete;
    ReclaimPermit& operator=(const ReclaimPermit&) = delete;
    ReclaimPermit(ReclaimPermit&& other) noexcept
        : identity_(other.identity_), state_(other.state_.load(std::memory_order_relaxed))
    {
        // move 元は無効化（同一 Permit の二重使用防止）
        other.state_.store(State::Consumed, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    }
    ReclaimPermit& operator=(ReclaimPermit&& other) noexcept
    {
        if (this != &other) {
            identity_ = other.identity_;
            state_.store(other.state_.load(std::memory_order_relaxed), std::memory_order_relaxed);
            other.state_.store(State::Consumed, std::memory_order_relaxed);
        }
        return *this;
    }

    [[nodiscard]] const ShutdownRuntimeIdentity& identity() const noexcept { return identity_; }

    // single-use consume（linearization point — 第七者 B / INV-LIFE-7）。
    // すでに Consumed の場合は false（二重 reclaim 構造的防止 — T9）。
    [[nodiscard]] bool consume() noexcept
    {
        State expected = State::Issued;
        return convo::compareExchangeAtomic(state_, expected, State::Consumed,
                                              std::memory_order_acq_rel,
                                              std::memory_order_acquire);
    }

    [[nodiscard]] bool isConsumed() const noexcept
    {
        return convo::consumeAtomic(state_, std::memory_order_acquire) == State::Consumed;
    }

private:
    friend class ShutdownRuntime;

    enum class State : uint8_t { Issued = 0, Consumed };

    explicit ReclaimPermit(ShutdownRuntimeIdentity id) noexcept : identity_(id) {}

    ShutdownRuntimeIdentity identity_;
    std::atomic<State> state_{State::Issued};
};

// ── ShutdownRuntime 拡張用 forward declaration ──────────────────────────────
//   tryMakeQuiescenceProof / tryMakeReclaimPermit は ShutdownRuntime のメソッドとして
//   ISRShutdown.h / ISRShutdown.cpp に追加する（H.11.11.3 / H.11.11.9.3）。

} // namespace isr
} // namespace convo
```

```
#include "ISRPayloadTier.h"

namespace convo {
namespace isr {

bool PayloadTierValidator::isValidTier(uint32_t tierValue) const noexcept
{
    return tierValue <= static_cast<uint32_t>(PayloadTier::Forbidden);
}

bool PayloadTierValidator::validateTierSequence(const std::vector<PayloadTier>& tiers) const noexcept
{
    if (tiers.empty()) {
        return false;
    }

    uint32_t prev = 0;
    bool first = true;
    for (const auto& tier : tiers) {
        const auto v = static_cast<uint32_t>(tier);
        if (!isValidTier(v) || tier == PayloadTier::Forbidden) {
            return false;
        }

        if (!first && v < prev) {
            return false;
        }

        prev = v;
        first = false;
    }

    for (const auto& dep : dependencies_) {
        bool hasFrom = false;
        bool hasTo = false;
        for (const auto& tier : tiers) {
            if (tier == dep.first) hasFrom = true;
            if (tier == dep.second) hasTo = true;
        }
        if (hasTo && !hasFrom) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    return true;
}

void PayloadTierValidator::registerTierDependency(PayloadTier from, PayloadTier to)
{
    dependencies_.emplace_back(from, to);
}

TierRejectReason PayloadTierValidator::explainPublishReject(const TieredPayloadDescriptor& descriptor) const noexcept
{
    if (!isValidTier(static_cast<uint32_t>(descriptor.tier))) {
        return TierRejectReason::InvalidTier;
    }

    if (descriptor.tier == PayloadTier::Forbidden) {
        return TierRejectReason::ForbiddenTier;
    }

    if (descriptor.tier == PayloadTier::RTLocalOnly) {
        return TierRejectReason::RTLocalLeak;
    }

    if (descriptor.requiresRT && descriptor.tier == PayloadTier::ExternalPinned && !descriptor.pinnedLifetime) {
        return TierRejectReason::ExternalPinnedWithoutLifetime;
    }

    if (descriptor.hasExternalResource && descriptor.tier == PayloadTier::InlineImmutable) {
        return TierRejectReason::InlineImmutableWithExternalResource;
    }

    return TierRejectReason::None;
}

bool PayloadTierValidator::isPublishAllowed(const TieredPayloadDescriptor& descriptor) const noexcept
{
    return explainPublishReject(descriptor) == TierRejectReason::None;
}

bool PayloadTierValidator::isDeferredReclaimRequired(const TieredPayloadDescriptor& descriptor) const noexcept
{
    if (descriptor.tier == PayloadTier::ExternalPinned) {
        return true;
    }

    return descriptor.hasExternalResource;
}

}  // namespace isr
}  // namespace convo
```

```
#pragma once

#include <cstdint>
#include <vector>

namespace convo {
namespace isr {

/**
 * ISR 10層 Architecture Layer 4: Payload Tier
 * publication の多層 staged publish を categorize する。
 */

/**
 * Payload tier enumeration
 * Tier の値が大きいほど、より後の publication stage
 */
enum class PayloadTier : uint32_t
{
    InlineImmutable,
    ImmutableShared,
    ExternalPinned,
    RTLocalOnly,
    Forbidden,
    Invalid = 0xFFFFFFFFu
};

struct TieredPayloadDescriptor
{
    PayloadTier tier = PayloadTier::Invalid;
    bool requiresRT = false;
    bool hasExternalResource = false;
    bool pinnedLifetime = false;
};

enum class TierRejectReason : uint8_t
{
    None = 0,
    InvalidTier,
    ForbiddenTier,
    RTLocalLeak,
    ExternalPinnedWithoutLifetime,
    InlineImmutableWithExternalResource
};

/**
 * Payload tier validator
 * publication order を enforce
 */
class PayloadTierValidator
{
public:
    // tier value を検証
    bool isValidTier(uint32_t tierValue) const noexcept;

    // tier sequence を検証（ordered publish か確認）
    bool validateTierSequence(const std::vector<PayloadTier>& tiers) const noexcept;

    // tier 依存グラフを register
    void registerTierDependency(PayloadTier from, PayloadTier to);
    TierRejectReason explainPublishReject(const TieredPayloadDescriptor& descriptor) const noexcept;
    bool isPublishAllowed(const TieredPayloadDescriptor& descriptor) const noexcept;
    bool isDeferredReclaimRequired(const TieredPayloadDescriptor& descriptor) const noexcept;

private:
    std::vector<std::pair<PayloadTier, PayloadTier>> dependencies_;
};

}  // namespace isr
}  // namespace convo
```

```
#include "ISRRetire.h"
#include <immintrin.h>  // _mm_pause
#include "ISRRetireOverflowRing.h"
#include "AtomicAccess.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>

namespace convo {
namespace isr {

void LifetimeState::initQueue() noexcept
{
    for (size_t i = 0; i < RETIRE_INTENT_QUEUE_SIZE; ++i) {
        convo::publishAtomic(slots_[i].sequence,
                             static_cast<uint64_t>(i),
                             std::memory_order_release);
    }
    convo::publishAtomic(enqueueTicket_, uint64_t{0}, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    convo::publishAtomic(dequeuePos_, uint64_t{0}, std::memory_order_relaxed);
}

void LifetimeState::emitRetireIntent(const RetireIntent& intent) noexcept
{
    // ★ Step 1: MPSC Queue に slot を予約 (Vyukov protocol)
    const uint64_t ticket = convo::fetchAddAtomic(enqueueTicket_, 1, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
    const size_t idx = ticket % RETIRE_INTENT_QUEUE_SIZE;

    RetireIntent localIntent = intent;

    // ★ Step 2: bounded spin — Consumer が slot を解放するまで待機
    static constexpr int kMaxProducerSpin = 64;
    for (int spin = 0;; ++spin) {
        uint64_t slotSeq = convo::consumeAtomic(
            slots_[idx].sequence, std::memory_order_acquire);
        if (slotSeq == ticket) break;  // slot 獲得

        if (spin >= kMaxProducerSpin) {
            // ★ bounded spin 失敗 → tombstone + fallback
            slots_[idx].payload = RetireIntent{};
            slots_[idx].payload.dspSlot = UINT32_MAX;  // tombstone 識別子
            convo::publishAtomic(slots_[idx].sequence, ticket + 1, std::memory_order_release);

            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(fallbackMutex_);
            if (fallbackCount_ < FALLBACK_QUEUE_CAPACITY) {
                const size_t tail = (fallbackHead_ + fallbackCount_) % FALLBACK_QUEUE_CAPACITY;
                fallbackQueue_[tail] = localIntent;
                ++fallbackCount_;
                (void)convo::fetchAddAtomic(overflowCount_, uint64_t{1}, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
            } else {
                // ★ Fallback も満杯 → OverflowRing へ退避試行
                bool dropped = true;
                if (overflowRing_ != nullptr) {
                    RetireOverflowEntry entry{localIntent, static_cast<uint64_t>(
                        std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::microseconds>(
                            std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch()).count()), 0};
                    if (overflowRing_->tryPush(entry)) {
                        convo::fetchAddAtomic(quarantineRescuedCount_, uint64_t{1}, std::memory_order_release);
                        dropped = false;
                    }
                }
                if (dropped) {
                    (void)convo::fetchAddAtomic(fallbackOverflowCount_, uint64_t{1}, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
                    (void)convo::fetchAddAtomic(overflowCount_, uint64_t{1}, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
                    (void)convo::fetchAddAtomic(droppedIntentCount_, uint64_t{1}, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
                }
            }

            // ★ C-1: overflowStartTimestamp_ を初回のみ設定（CAS）
            uint64_t expected = 0;
            convo::compareExchangeAtomic(overflowStartTimestamp_, expected,
                static_cast<uint64_t>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch().count()),
                std::memory_order_release);
            (void)convo::fetchAddAtomic(overflowWindowCounter_, uint64_t{1}, std::memory_order_release);
            convo::publishAtomic(lastOverflowTicks_,
                static_cast<uint64_t>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch().count()),
                std::memory_order_release);
            return;
        }
        _mm_pause();
    }

    // ★ C-1: success（キュー空きあり）: overflow が継続中ならタイムスタンプをリセット
    uint64_t prevStart = convo::exchangeAtomic(overflowStartTimestamp_, uint64_t{0},
        std::memory_order_release);
    (void)prevStart;

    // ★ Step 3: payload 書き込み + release
    slots_[idx].payload = localIntent;
    convo::publishAtomic(slots_[idx].sequence, ticket + 1, std::memory_order_release);
}

void LifetimeState::emitRetireIntentNonRT(const RetireIntent& intent) noexcept
{
    // ★ Finding 9 + work92 B-1 (big 1-7 リネーム):
    //   「RT」は RealTime thread safety を意味しない。実装は emitRetireIntent() を
    //   素通しし、輻輳時に std::mutex をロックする（:44/:135/:265 の lock_guard）。
    //   現時点では呼び出し元（AudioEngine.Commit.cpp:485）は全て非 RT スレッドである
    //   ことを確認済み。将来 Audio Thread から呼ぶ場合は mutex を使わない別実装を
    //   用意すること（リネーム済みのため RT 誤用の API 誤解リスクは解消）。
    //   注: jassert(!isAudioThread()) は ISRRetire.cpp では JUCE ヘッダ未インクルードのため使用不可
    emitRetireIntent(intent);
}

bool LifetimeState::dequeueOne(RetireIntent& out) noexcept
{
    for (;;) {
        const uint64_t pos = convo::consumeAtomic(dequeuePos_, std::memory_order_relaxed);
        const size_t idx = static_cast<size_t>(pos % RETIRE_INTENT_QUEUE_SIZE);
        const uint64_t expectedSeq = pos + 1;
        const uint64_t slotSeq = convo::consumeAtomic(
            slots_[idx].sequence, std::memory_order_acquire);
        if (slotSeq != expectedSeq) return false;  // 未 ready

        out = slots_[idx].payload;
        // ★ tombstone check: dspSlot == UINT32_MAX で fallback 経由の無効 intent を識別
        if (out.dspSlot == UINT32_MAX) {
            convo::publishAtomic(slots_[idx].sequence,
                pos + RETIRE_INTENT_QUEUE_SIZE,
                std::memory_order_release);
            convo::publishAtomic(dequeuePos_, pos + 1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
            continue;  // 次へ (ループ)
        }
        // ★ slot 解放: sequence = dequeuePos + SIZE → 次 cycle Producer が再利用可能
        convo::publishAtomic(slots_[idx].sequence,
            pos + RETIRE_INTENT_QUEUE_SIZE,
            std::memory_order_release);
        convo::publishAtomic(dequeuePos_, pos + 1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
        return true;
    }
}

bool LifetimeState::dequeueFallback(RetireIntent& out) noexcept
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(fallbackMutex_);
    const size_t count = convo::consumeAtomic(fallbackCount_, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    if (count == 0) return false;
    out = fallbackQueue_[fallbackHead_];
    fallbackHead_ = (fallbackHead_ + 1) % FALLBACK_QUEUE_CAPACITY;
    convo::publishAtomic(fallbackCount_, count - 1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    return true;
}

std::vector<RetireIntent> LifetimeState::dequeuePendingRetireIntents() noexcept
{
    std::vector<RetireIntent> result;
    result.reserve(128);

    // 1. Drain Vyukov MPSC queue + Fallback (fair scheduling: main 8 : fallback 1)
    {
        constexpr size_t kMainToFallbackRatio = 8;
        RetireIntent raw;
        while (true) {
            bool progressed = false;
            for (size_t i = 0; i < kMainToFallbackRatio; ++i) {
                if (!dequeueOne(raw)) break;
                result.push_back(raw);
                progressed = true;
            }
            if (dequeueFallback(raw)) {
                result.push_back(raw);
                progressed = true;
            }
            if (!progressed) break;
        }
    }

    // ★ Phase 5: 複合ソートキー (priority, retireEpoch, generation, dspSlot)
    std::stable_sort(result.begin(), result.end(), [](const RetireIntent& lhs, const RetireIntent& rhs) noexcept {
        if (lhs.priority != rhs.priority)
            return lhs.priority > rhs.priority;  // priority降順（Critical最先頭）
        if (lhs.retireEpoch != rhs.retireEpoch)
            return lhs.retireEpoch < rhs.retireEpoch;
        if (lhs.generation != rhs.generation)
            return lhs.generation < rhs.generation;
        return lhs.dspSlot < rhs.dspSlot;
    });

    return result;
}

std::uint64_t LifetimeState::pendingIntentCount() const noexcept
{
    const uint64_t enqueued = convo::consumeAtomic(enqueueTicket_, std::memory_order_acquire);
    const uint64_t consumed = convo::consumeAtomic(dequeuePos_, std::memory_order_acquire);
    const uint64_t mainPending = (enqueued > consumed) ? (enqueued - consumed) : 0;
    const uint64_t fbPending = convo::consumeAtomic(fallbackCount_, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    return mainPending + fbPending;
}

std::uint64_t LifetimeState::overflowCount() const noexcept
{
    return convo::consumeAtomic(overflowCount_, std::memory_order_acquire);
}

std::uint64_t LifetimeState::droppedIntentCount() const noexcept
{
    return convo::consumeAtomic(droppedIntentCount_, std::memory_order_acquire);
}

void LifetimeState::acknowledgeRetireCoordination(const RetireIntent& intent)
{
    const auto idx = static_cast<std::size_t>(intent.dspSlot % RETIRE_INTENT_QUEUE_SIZE);
    convo::publishAtomic(acknowledgeGeneration_[idx], intent.generation, std::memory_order_release);
    (void)convo::fetchAddAtomic(acknowledgedCount_, uint64_t{1}, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
}

// ★ C-1: overflow 継続時間追跡 getter
std::uint64_t LifetimeState::overflowStartTimestamp() const noexcept
{
    return convo::consumeAtomic(overflowStartTimestamp_, std::memory_order_acquire);
}

std::uint64_t LifetimeState::lastOverflowTicks() const noexcept
{
    return convo::consumeAtomic(lastOverflowTicks_, std::memory_order_acquire);
}

std::uint64_t LifetimeState::overflowWindowCounter() const noexcept
{
    return convo::consumeAtomic(overflowWindowCounter_, std::memory_order_acquire);
}

std::uint64_t LifetimeState::lastOverflowWindowCount() const noexcept
{
    return convo::consumeAtomic(lastOverflowWindowCount_, std::memory_order_acquire);
}

// ★ P1: Fallback queue metrics
std::size_t LifetimeState::fallbackOccupancy() const noexcept
{
    return convo::consumeAtomic(fallbackCount_, std::memory_order_acquire);
}

std::uint64_t LifetimeState::fallbackOverflowCount() const noexcept
{
    return convo::consumeAtomic(fallbackOverflowCount_, std::memory_order_acquire);
}

// ★ Phase5: 全保留中Intentの優先度を底上げ（Shutdown時の Critical 一括昇格用）
//   Shutdown/AudioStopped 後は Audio Thread が動作していないため、
//   MPSC queue + fallback queue の走査は安全。
//   ※ isValid/priority は std::atomic ではないが、Shutdown中は単一スレッドアクセス。
void LifetimeState::escalateAllRetires(RetirePriority minPriority) noexcept
{
    // Vyukov MPSC slots: 全スロットを走査
    for (size_t i = 0; i < RETIRE_INTENT_QUEUE_SIZE; ++i)
    {
        auto& intent = slots_[i].payload;
        // ★ dspSlot != UINT32_MAX で有効な intent を識別 (isValid 廃止)
        if (intent.dspSlot != UINT32_MAX
            && static_cast<uint8_t>(intent.priority) < static_cast<uint8_t>(minPriority))
        {
            intent.priority = minPriority;
        }
    }

    // Fallback queue: 全エントリを走査
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(fallbackMutex_);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < fallbackCount_; ++i)
        {
            const size_t idx = (fallbackHead_ + i) % FALLBACK_QUEUE_CAPACITY;
            auto& intent = fallbackQueue_[idx];
            if (static_cast<uint8_t>(intent.priority) < static_cast<uint8_t>(minPriority))
            {
                intent.priority = minPriority;
            }
        }
    }
}

}  // namespace isr
}  // namespace convo

```
```
#pragma once

#include <atomic>
#include <cstdint>
#include <vector>
#include <array>
#include <mutex>

#include "AtomicAccess.h"
#include "ISRAuthorityClass.h"  // RetirePriority
#include "ISRRetireRuntimeEx.h"  // ★ A2: EpochControl (owned by LifetimeState)

namespace convo {
namespace isr {

// ★ Phase 1: 前方宣言（ISRRetireOverflowRing.h で完全定義）
class RetireOverflowRing;

/**
 * ISR 10層 Architecture Layer 7: RetireIntent
 * RT から retire intent を emit し、NonRT側で coordination
 */

/**
 * Retire intention descriptor
 *
 * ★ B14: isValid 廃止 — slot.sequence が slot 状態の唯一の Authority。
 *    無効な intent (tombstone) は dspSlot == UINT32_MAX で識別する。
 *    これにより atomic<bool> 問題が完全に回避され、RetireIntent は
 *    trivially copyable かつ 64 バイト以下を維持できる。
 */
struct RetireIntent
{
    uint32_t dspSlot;
    uint64_t generation;  // ★ B-1: 64bit化
    uint64_t retireEpoch;
    // ★ Phase 5: 優先度フィールド（デフォルト Normal）
    RetirePriority priority{RetirePriority::Normal};
};

/**
 * ★ B14: Vyukov MPSC Queue slot
 */
struct RetireSlot {
    RetireIntent payload;
    std::atomic<uint64_t> sequence{0};
};

/**
 * Retire runtime
 */
class LifetimeState
{
public:
    // Generic helper used internally / non-RT paths.
    void emitRetireIntent(const RetireIntent& intent) noexcept;

    // Preferred API for runtime retire intent publication from commit path.
    void emitRetireIntentNonRT(const RetireIntent& intent) noexcept;

    // ★ B14: Vyukov MPSC 新 API
    void initQueue() noexcept;
    bool dequeueOne(RetireIntent& out) noexcept;
    bool dequeueFallback(RetireIntent& out) noexcept;

    // NonRT: dequeue retire intents (backward compat, built on dequeueOne/dequeueFallback)
    std::vector<RetireIntent> dequeuePendingRetireIntents() noexcept;

    [[nodiscard]] std::uint64_t pendingIntentCount() const noexcept;
    [[nodiscard]] std::uint64_t overflowCount() const noexcept;
    [[nodiscard]] std::uint64_t droppedIntentCount() const noexcept;

    // ★ P1: Fallback queue metrics
    [[nodiscard]] std::size_t fallbackOccupancy() const noexcept;

    // ★ Phase5: 全保留中Intentの優先度を底上げ（Shutdown時の Critical 一括昇格用）
    void escalateAllRetires(RetirePriority minPriority) noexcept;
    [[nodiscard]] std::uint64_t fallbackOverflowCount() const noexcept;

    // ★ C-1: overflow 継続時間追跡
    [[nodiscard]] std::uint64_t overflowStartTimestamp() const noexcept;
    [[nodiscard]] std::uint64_t lastOverflowTicks() const noexcept;
    [[nodiscard]] std::uint64_t overflowWindowCounter() const noexcept;
    [[nodiscard]] std::uint64_t lastOverflowWindowCount() const noexcept;

    // NonRT: acknowledge retire coordination
    void acknowledgeRetireCoordination(const RetireIntent& intent);

    // ★ Phase 1: OverflowRing 連携
    void setOverflowRing(RetireOverflowRing* ring) noexcept { overflowRing_ = ring; }
    [[nodiscard]] RetireOverflowRing* getOverflowRing() const noexcept { return overflowRing_; }

    // ★ Phase 1: OverflowRing 救済統計
    [[nodiscard]] std::uint64_t quarantineRescuedCount() const noexcept
    {
        return convo::consumeAtomic(quarantineRescuedCount_, std::memory_order_acquire);
    }

    // ★ B14: Queue Pressure 診断 (HealthMonitor 用)
    [[nodiscard]] uint64_t approxQueueDepth() const noexcept
    {
        const uint64_t enqueued = convo::consumeAtomic(enqueueTicket_, std::memory_order_acquire);
        const uint64_t consumed = convo::consumeAtomic(dequeuePos_, std::memory_order_acquire);
        const uint64_t mainPending = (enqueued > consumed) ? (enqueued - consumed) : 0;
        const uint64_t fbPending = convo::consumeAtomic(fallbackCount_, std::memory_order_relaxed);
        return mainPending + fbPending;
    }

    // ★ A2: EpochControl delegation — thin Authority API.
    //   LifetimeState owns EpochControl privately; AudioEngine / ISR Handler reach
    //   epoch control only via RuntimeWorldAuthority::lifetime() (HANDLER-1 boundary).
    void reclaim(std::uint32_t slot) { epochControl_.reclaim(slot); }
    void emitRetireTrace(const std::filesystem::path& outputPath) const noexcept { epochControl_.emitRetireTrace(outputPath); }
    void requestRollback() noexcept { epochControl_.requestRollback(); }
    [[nodiscard]] bool isGracePeriodCompleted(std::uint64_t worldGeneration,
                                               std::uint64_t maxObservedGeneration,
                                               std::uint32_t audioCallbackActiveCount) const noexcept
    { return epochControl_.isGracePeriodCompleted(worldGeneration, maxObservedGeneration, audioCallbackActiveCount); }
    [[nodiscard]] bool hasExceededDeferralThresholds(std::uint64_t retireDeferralEpochs,
                                                      double retireDeferralWallClockMs,
                                                      std::uint64_t maxRetireDeferralEpochs,
                                                      double maxRetireWallClockMs) const noexcept
    { return epochControl_.hasExceededDeferralThresholds(retireDeferralEpochs, retireDeferralWallClockMs, maxRetireDeferralEpochs, maxRetireWallClockMs); }
    void emitIntent(std::uint32_t slot, std::uint64_t generation) { epochControl_.emitIntent(slot, generation); }
    void enqueueRetire(std::uint32_t slot) { epochControl_.enqueueRetire(slot); }
    void settleEpoch(std::uint32_t slot) { epochControl_.settleEpoch(slot); }
    [[nodiscard]] bool canReclaimAfterEscalation(bool noReader, bool noExecutorReference, bool noPendingTransition) const noexcept
    { return epochControl_.canReclaimAfterEscalation(noReader, noExecutorReference, noPendingTransition); }
    [[nodiscard]] bool canTransitionRetirePendingToFree(bool graceCompleted,
                                                        bool pendingIntentOwned,
                                                        bool authoritativeOwnershipReleased) const noexcept
    { return epochControl_.canTransitionRetirePendingToFree(graceCompleted, pendingIntentOwned, authoritativeOwnershipReleased); }
    [[nodiscard]] RetireLane laneOf(std::uint32_t slot) const noexcept { return epochControl_.laneOf(slot); }
    [[nodiscard]] std::uint64_t getQuarantineResidentCount() const noexcept { return epochControl_.getQuarantineResidentCount(); }
    void quarantine(std::uint32_t slot) { epochControl_.quarantine(slot); }
    [[nodiscard]] bool canRollback() const noexcept { return epochControl_.canRollback(); }
    void setRollbackMode(EpochMode mode) noexcept { epochControl_.setRollbackMode(mode); }
    void emitRetireTimeline(const std::filesystem::path& outputPath) const { epochControl_.emitRetireTimeline(outputPath); }

private:
    // ★ Phase 1: OverflowRing（純粋保存ストア、Coordinator管理）
    RetireOverflowRing* overflowRing_ = nullptr;
    EpochControl epochControl_;

    // ★ B14: Vyukov MPSC Queue
    //    Producer: fetch_add(ticket) → slot.sequence で spin → payload 書き込み → sequence++
    //    Consumer: dequeuePos_ から slot.sequence 確認 → payload 読取 → sequence += SIZE で解放
    std::atomic<uint64_t> enqueueTicket_{0};
    std::atomic<uint64_t> dequeuePos_{0};  // Consumer 専有だが HealthMonitor が読むため atomic

    static constexpr size_t RETIRE_INTENT_QUEUE_SIZE = 256;
    RetireSlot slots_[RETIRE_INTENT_QUEUE_SIZE];
    std::array<std::atomic<uint64_t>, RETIRE_INTENT_QUEUE_SIZE> acknowledgeGeneration_{};  // ★ B-1: 64bit化
    std::atomic<uint64_t> acknowledgedCount_{0};
    std::atomic<uint64_t> overflowCount_{0};
    std::atomic<uint64_t> droppedIntentCount_{0};

    // ★ Phase 1: OverflowRing救済カウンタ
    std::atomic<uint64_t> quarantineRescuedCount_{0};

    // ★ B14: Fallback — head/tail 管理の循環バッファ (mutex保護, O(1) head移動)
    static constexpr size_t FALLBACK_QUEUE_CAPACITY = 4096;
    RetireIntent fallbackQueue_[FALLBACK_QUEUE_CAPACITY];
    size_t fallbackHead_{0};
    std::atomic<size_t> fallbackCount_{0};
    std::atomic<uint64_t> fallbackOverflowCount_{0};
    mutable std::mutex fallbackMutex_;

    // ★ C-1: overflow 継続時間追跡
    std::atomic<uint64_t> lastOverflowTicks_{0};
    std::atomic<uint64_t> overflowStartTimestamp_{0};
    std::atomic<uint64_t> overflowWindowCounter_{0};
    std::atomic<uint64_t> lastOverflowWindowCount_{0};
    std::atomic<uint64_t> lastOverflowWindowResetTicks_{0};
};

}  // namespace isr
}  // namespace convo
```

### 📄 `src\audioengine\ISRRetireLatency.h`

```
#pragma once

#include <atomic>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>
#include <vector>

namespace convo {
namespace isr {

/**
 * Retire latency recorder (D1: retire request -> actual free)
 *
 * 設計上の約束:
 *  - 固定容量のスロット配列とアトミック操作のみを使う。動的確保もロックもしない。
 *  - requestId は単調増加で、0 を払い出さない。ラップしたら払い出しを止める（再利用しない）。
 *  - 対応付けはポインタ（オブジェクト同一性）で行い、epoch は記録用に持つだけ。
 *  - 完了は CAS で 1 回だけ取り出す。2 回目の完了は unmatched として数え、上書きしない。
 *  - スロット満杯は overflow として数え、その要求は観測に含めない。
 *  - スロットは state で 3 段階（free / filling / ready）にし、書込み途中の公開を防ぐ。
 */
class RetireLatencyRecorder
{
public:
    enum class Path : std::uint8_t
    {
        Sync = 0,        // terminalReclaim の同期解放
        Drain,           // TerminalReclaimAuthority::drain
        DrainAll,        // TerminalReclaimAuthority::drainAll（終了時の全排水）
        Queue,           // DeferredDeletionQueue::reclaim
        QueueOverflow,   // DeletionQueue::enqueue の容量超過による即時解放
        Quarantine,      // RetireQuarantineStore::drain
        Count
    };

    static constexpr std::size_t kPathCount = static_cast<std::size_t> (Path::Count);
    static constexpr std::size_t kSlots = 512;
    static constexpr std::size_t kRanges = 8;                    // RT スレッドごとの区画数
    static constexpr std::size_t kRangeSize = kSlots / kRanges;  // 1 区画 64 スロット
    static constexpr std::size_t kObservationCapacity = 256;
    static constexpr std::uint64_t kThresholdNs = 50'000'000ull;   // 50 ms（変更しない）

    static const char* pathName (Path p) noexcept
    {
        switch (p)
        {
            case Path::Sync:          return "sync";
            case Path::Drain:         return "drain";
            case Path::DrainAll:      return "drainAll";
            case Path::Queue:         return "queue";
            case Path::QueueOverflow: return "queueOverflow";
            case Path::Quarantine:    return "quarantine";
            default:                  return "unknown";
        }
    }

    static RetireLatencyRecorder& instance() noexcept
    {
        static RetireLatencyRecorder recorder;
        return recorder;
    }

    // 要求を記録する。戻り値 0 は「記録できなかった」（容量不足・ID 枯渇）。
    std::uint64_t recordRequest (const void* object, std::uint64_t epoch,
                                 std::uint64_t minReaderEpoch = 0,
                                 std::uint32_t minReaderSlot = 0xFFFFFFFFu,
                                 bool* created = nullptr) noexcept
    {
        if (created != nullptr)
            *created = false;
        if (object == nullptr)
            return 0;

        // 終了処理（drainAll 以降）の要求は測定対象外として別集計する
        if (shutdownPhase_.load (std::memory_order_acquire))
        {
            addCount (postShutdown_);
            addCount (recordMisses_);   // ★ C5: 計測上の欠落を検出可能にする
            return 0;
        }

        const std::uint64_t id = nextId_.fetch_add (1u, std::memory_order_relaxed) + 1u;

        if (id == 0u || id == std::numeric_limits<std::uint64_t>::max())
        {
            addCount (idExhausted_);
            addCount (recordMisses_);   // ★ C5: 計測上の欠落を検出可能にする
            return 0;
        }

        // 同じポインタの再 enqueue（リトライ段階）では既存の要求を再利用する。
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < kSlots; ++i)
        {
            const std::uint8_t state = slots_[i].state.load (std::memory_order_acquire);

            if (state != kStateFree
                && slots_[i].object.load (std::memory_order_acquire) == object)
            {
                // 既存記録。作成フラグは false のまま。未確定の最小 reader 情報だけ補完する
                //   （既知の情報は上書きしない）。
                if (minReaderSlot != 0xFFFFFFFFu
                    && slots_[i].minReaderSlot.load (std::memory_order_relaxed) == 0xFFFFFFFFu)
                {
                    slots_[i].minReaderEpoch.store (minReaderEpoch, std::memory_order_relaxed);
                    slots_[i].minReaderSlot.store (minReaderSlot, std::memory_order_relaxed);
                }

                return slots_[i].id.load (std::memory_order_relaxed);
            }
        }

        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < kSlots; ++i)
        {
            std::uint8_t expected = kStateFree;

            if (! slots_[i].state.compare_exchange_strong (expected, kStateFilling,
                                                           std::memory_order_acq_rel,
                                                           std::memory_order_relaxed))
            {
                continue;
            }

            slots_[i].object.store (object, std::memory_order_relaxed);
            slots_[i].id.store (id, std::memory_order_relaxed);
            slots_[i].tsNs.store (nowNs(), std::memory_order_relaxed);
            slots_[i].safeTsNs.store (0, std::memory_order_relaxed);
            slots_[i].epoch.store (epoch, std::memory_order_relaxed);
            slots_[i].minReaderEpoch.store (minReaderEpoch, std::memory_order_relaxed);
            slots_[i].minReaderSlot.store (minReaderSlot, std::memory_order_relaxed);
            slots_[i].state.store (kStateReady, std::memory_order_release);

            addCount (requests_);

            if (created != nullptr)
                *created = true;

            return id;
        }

        addCount (overflow_);
        addCount (recordMisses_);   // ★ C5: 計測上の欠落を検出可能にする
        return 0;
    }

    // RT 経路用: TLS で確保した区画の中だけを走査する（O(kRangeSize)、確保・ロックなし）。
    std::uint64_t recordRequestRT (const void* object, std::uint64_t epoch,
                                   std::uint64_t minReaderEpoch = 0,
                                   bool* created = nullptr) noexcept
    {
        if (created != nullptr)
            *created = false;
        if (object == nullptr)
            return 0;

        if (shutdownPhase_.load (std::memory_order_acquire))
        {
            addCount (postShutdown_);
            addCount (recordMisses_);   // ★ C5: 計測上の欠落を検出可能にする
            return 0;
        }

        const std::uint64_t id = nextId_.fetch_add (1u, std::memory_order_relaxed) + 1u;

        if (id == 0u || id == std::numeric_limits<std::uint64_t>::max())
        {
            addCount (idExhausted_);
            addCount (recordMisses_);   // ★ C5: 計測上の欠落を検出可能にする
            return 0;
        }

        const std::uint32_t range = rangeForCurrentThread();
        const std::size_t begin = static_cast<std::size_t> (range) * kRangeSize;
        const std::size_t end = begin + kRangeSize;

        for (std::size_t i = begin; i < end; ++i)
        {
            std::uint8_t expected = kStateFree;

            if (! slots_[i].state.compare_exchange_strong (expected, kStateFilling,
                                                           std::memory_order_acq_rel,
                                                           std::memory_order_relaxed))
            {
                continue;
            }

            slots_[i].object.store (object, std::memory_order_relaxed);
            slots_[i].id.store (id, std::memory_order_relaxed);
            slots_[i].tsNs.store (nowNs(), std::memory_order_relaxed);
            slots_[i].safeTsNs.store (0, std::memory_order_relaxed);
            slots_[i].epoch.store (epoch, std::memory_order_relaxed);
            slots_[i].minReaderEpoch.store (minReaderEpoch, std::memory_order_relaxed);
            slots_[i].minReaderSlot.store (0xFFFFFFFFu, std::memory_order_relaxed);
            slots_[i].state.store (kStateReady, std::memory_order_release);

            addCount (requests_);
            rtRequests_.fetch_add (1u, std::memory_order_acq_rel);

            if (created != nullptr)
                *created = true;

            return id;
        }

        addCount (overflow_);
        addCount (recordMisses_);   // ★ C5: 計測上の欠落を検出可能にする
        return 0;
    }

    // 指定 ID の記録だけを取り消す（object・id・ready の 3 条件が一致したときのみ）。
    void cancelRequestById (const void* object, std::uint64_t requestId) noexcept
    {
        if (object == nullptr || requestId == 0u)
            return;

        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < kSlots; ++i)
        {
            if (slots_[i].state.load (std::memory_order_acquire) != kStateReady)
                continue;

            if (slots_[i].object.load (std::memory_order_acquire) != object)
                continue;

            if (slots_[i].id.load (std::memory_order_relaxed) != requestId)
                continue;

            std::uint8_t expected = kStateReady;

            if (slots_[i].state.compare_exchange_strong (expected, kStateFree,
                                                         std::memory_order_acq_rel,
                                                         std::memory_order_acquire))
            {
                addCount (cancelled_);
            }

            return;
        }
    }

    // RT 版: TLS 区画内だけを走査する（O(kRangeSize)、ロック・確保なし）。
    void cancelRequestRTById (const void* object, std::uint64_t requestId) noexcept
    {
        if (object == nullptr || requestId == 0u)
            return;

        const std::uint32_t range = rangeForCurrentThread();
        const std::size_t begin = static_cast<std::size_t> (range) * kRangeSize;
        const std::size_t end = begin + kRangeSize;

        for (std::size_t i = begin; i < end; ++i)
        {
            if (slots_[i].state.load (std::memory_order_acquire) != kStateReady)
                continue;

            if (slots_[i].object.load (std::memory_order_acquire) != object)
                continue;

            if (slots_[i].id.load (std::memory_order_relaxed) != requestId)
                continue;

            std::uint8_t expected = kStateReady;

            if (slots_[i].state.compare_exchange_strong (expected, kStateFree,
                                                         std::memory_order_acq_rel,
                                                         std::memory_order_acquire))
            {
                addCount (cancelled_);
            }

            return;
        }
    }

    // enqueue に失敗した要求を取り消す（観測に含めない）。
    void cancelRequest (const void* object) noexcept
    {
        std::size_t index = 0;

        if (claim (object, index))
        {
            slots_[index].state.store (kStateFree, std::memory_order_release);
            addCount (cancelled_);
        }
    }

    // EBR 安全条件を満たした時刻を記録する（最初の 1 回だけ）。
    void recordSafe (const void* object) noexcept
    {
        if (object == nullptr)
            return;

        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < kSlots; ++i)
        {
            if (slots_[i].state.load (std::memory_order_acquire) != kStateReady)
                continue;

            if (slots_[i].object.load (std::memory_order_acquire) != object)
                continue;

            const std::uint64_t now = nowNs();
            std::uint64_t expected = 0;

            slots_[i].safeTsNs.compare_exchange_strong (expected, now,
                                                        std::memory_order_acq_rel,
                                                        std::memory_order_relaxed);
            return;
        }
    }

    // 解放完了を記録する。対応する要求が無ければ unmatched として数える。
    void recordComplete (const void* object, Path path, std::uint64_t firstScanTsNs = 0) noexcept
    {
        // ★ W-2: shutdown 相以降の完了を要求拒否数とは別に数える
        if (shutdownPhase_.load (std::memory_order_acquire))
            addCount (postShutdownCompletions_);

        std::size_t index = 0;

        if (! claim (object, index))
        {
            addCount (unmatchedCompletions_);
            return;
        }

        const std::uint64_t id = slots_[index].id.load (std::memory_order_relaxed);
        const std::uint64_t ts = slots_[index].tsNs.load (std::memory_order_relaxed);
        const std::uint64_t safeTs = slots_[index].safeTsNs.load (std::memory_order_relaxed);
        const std::uint64_t epoch = slots_[index].epoch.load (std::memory_order_relaxed);
        const std::uint64_t minReaderEpoch = slots_[index].minReaderEpoch.load (std::memory_order_relaxed);
        const std::uint32_t minReaderSlot = slots_[index].minReaderSlot.load (std::memory_order_relaxed);
        slots_[index].state.store (kStateFree, std::memory_order_release);

        const std::uint64_t now = nowNs();
        const std::uint64_t latency = (now >= ts) ? (now - ts) : 0u;

        addCount (completions_);
        accumulatePath (path, latency);

        // EBR 待ちと実行待ちの分離（safeTs が観測できた場合のみ）
        if (safeTs != 0 && safeTs >= ts)
        {
            const std::uint64_t ebrNs = safeTs - ts;
            const std::uint64_t execNs = (now >= safeTs) ? (now - safeTs) : 0u;
            ebrCount_.fetch_add (1u, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
            ebrSumNs_.fetch_add (ebrNs, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
            execCount_.fetch_add (1u, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
            execSumNs_.fetch_add (execNs, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
            updateMax (ebrMaxNs_, ebrNs);
            updateMax (execMaxNs_, execNs);
        }
        else
        {
            unobservedSafe_.fetch_add (1u, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
        }

        // ★ 段階③ (2026-11-11, Owner 承認): 3 分類の計算と集計
        //   既存の latency / ebr / exec の計算は上で終っている（判定は完全に不変）。
        //   safeTs は生の値を渡す（safeTs < ts の順序不整合を
        //   excluded に落とさず consistencyErrors に拾うため）。
        const Classification cls = classifyTimes (ts, firstScanTsNs, safeTs, now);
        const std::size_t pathIndex = static_cast<std::size_t> (path);
        if (cls.excluded)
        {
            if (pathIndex < kPathCount)
                classExcluded_[pathIndex].fetch_add (1u, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
            classExcludedTotal_.fetch_add (1u, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
        }
        else if (cls.inconsistent)
        {
            classConsistencyErrors_.fetch_add (1u, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
            accumulateUnclassified (pathIndex, cls.unclassifiedNs);
        }
        else if (cls.classified)
        {
            classClassifiedTotal_.fetch_add (1u, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
            accumulateComponent (driverCount_[pathIndex], driverSumNs_[pathIndex],
                                 driverMaxNs_[pathIndex], driverOver_[pathIndex], cls.driverWaitNs);
            accumulateComponent (ebrCountC_[pathIndex], ebrSumNsC_[pathIndex],
                                 ebrMaxNsC_[pathIndex], ebrOverC_[pathIndex], cls.ebrWaitNs);
            accumulateComponent (execCountC_[pathIndex], execSumNsC_[pathIndex],
                                 execMaxNsC_[pathIndex], execOverC_[pathIndex], cls.execWaitNs);
            // ★ 残差が実際にあるときだけ unclassified に数える（
            //   分類できた要求を unclassified に加算しない）。
            if (cls.unclassifiedNs > 0u)
                accumulateUnclassified (pathIndex, cls.unclassifiedNs);
        }
        else
        {
            accumulateUnclassified (pathIndex, cls.unclassifiedNs);
        }

        appendObservation (id, epoch, latency, path, ts,
                           (safeTs != 0 && safeTs >= ts) ? safeTs : 0,
                           minReaderEpoch, minReaderSlot,
                           firstScanTsNs, cls);
    }

    struct PathStats
    {
        std::uint64_t count = 0;
        std::uint64_t overThreshold = 0;
        std::uint64_t maxNs = 0;
    };

    // ★ 段階③: 3 分類のパス別集計（診断用。形式は設計書 §2 の JSON に対応）
    struct ClassComponent
    {
        std::uint64_t count = 0;
        std::uint64_t sumNs = 0;
        std::uint64_t maxNs = 0;
        std::uint64_t overThreshold = 0;
    };
    struct ClassifiedPath
    {
        ClassComponent driverWait;
        ClassComponent ebrWait;
        ClassComponent execWait;
        std::uint64_t unclassifiedCount = 0;
        std::uint64_t unclassifiedSumNs = 0;
        std::uint64_t excludedCount = 0;   // safeTs 未観測（分類対象外）
    };
    struct ClassifiedTotals
    {
        std::uint64_t requests = 0;
        std::uint64_t completions = 0;
        std::uint64_t classified = 0;
        std::uint64_t unclassified = 0;
        std::uint64_t excluded = 0;
        std::uint64_t consistencyErrors = 0;
        std::uint64_t pending = 0;
    };

    // ★ 段階③: 時刻から 3 分類を計算する純関数（テスト可能にするため public）
    struct Classification
    {
        bool excluded = false;      // safeTs 未観測（分類しない）
        bool inconsistent = false;  // 順序不整合（unclassified に全額）
        bool classified = false;
        std::uint64_t driverWaitNs = 0;
        std::uint64_t ebrWaitNs = 0;
        std::uint64_t execWaitNs = 0;
        std::uint64_t unclassifiedNs = 0;
    };
    static Classification classifyTimes (std::uint64_t ts,
                                         std::uint64_t firstScanTs,
                                         std::uint64_t safeTs,
                                         std::uint64_t now) noexcept
    {
        Classification c;
        const std::uint64_t latency = (now >= ts) ? (now - ts) : 0u;
        if (safeTs == 0)
        {
            c.excluded = true;            // 既存の unobservedSafe に計上される層
            return c;
        }
        if (firstScanTs == 0)
        {
            c.unclassifiedNs = latency;   // 一度も走査されない（drainAll など）
            return c;
        }
        if (firstScanTs < ts || safeTs < firstScanTs)
        {
            c.inconsistent = true;
            c.unclassifiedNs = latency;
            return c;
        }
        c.driverWaitNs = firstScanTs - ts;
        c.ebrWaitNs = safeTs - firstScanTs;
        c.execWaitNs = (now >= safeTs) ? (now - safeTs) : 0u;
        const std::uint64_t sum = c.driverWaitNs + c.ebrWaitNs + c.execWaitNs;
        if (sum > latency)
        {
            c.inconsistent = true;        // 時刻の年代があわない（0 埋めしない）
            c.driverWaitNs = 0;
            c.ebrWaitNs = 0;
            c.execWaitNs = 0;
            c.unclassifiedNs = latency;
            return c;
        }
        c.classified = true;
        c.unclassifiedNs = latency - sum;  // 実際の残差（0 埋めしない）
        return c;
    }

    struct Observation
    {
        std::uint64_t requestId = 0;
        std::uint64_t epoch = 0;
        std::uint64_t latencyNs = 0;
        std::uint8_t path = 0;
        std::uint64_t enqueueTsNs = 0;     // 要求時刻
        std::uint64_t safeTsNs = 0;        // EBR 安全到達時刻（0 = 未観測）
        std::uint64_t minReaderEpoch = 0;  // 要求時の最小 reader epoch
        std::uint32_t minReaderSlot = 0xFFFFFFFFu; // その保持スロット
        // ★ 段階③ (2026-11-11, Owner 承認): 3 分類診断（追加・既存の判定は不変）
        std::uint64_t firstScanTsNs = 0;   // 最初にreclaim走査で評価された時刻（0 = 未走査）
        std::uint64_t driverWaitNs = 0;    // firstScanTs - ts
        std::uint64_t ebrWaitNs = 0;       // safeTs - firstScanTs
        std::uint64_t execWaitNs = 0;      // now - safeTs
        std::uint64_t unclassifiedNs = 0;  // latency - (driver+ebr+exec)（負なら latency 全額）
        std::uint8_t classified = 0;       // 1 = 3 分類成立 / 0 = 未分類
    };

    struct Snapshot
    {
        std::uint64_t requests = 0;
        std::uint64_t completions = 0;
        std::uint64_t unmatchedCompletions = 0;
        std::uint64_t overflow = 0;
        std::uint64_t idExhausted = 0;
        std::uint64_t cancelled = 0;
        std::uint64_t postShutdownRequests = 0;   // drainAll 以降の要求
        std::uint64_t postShutdownCompletions = 0; // ★ W-2: shutdown 相以降の完了
        std::uint64_t recordMisses = 0;           // ★ C5: 記録できなかった要求
        std::uint64_t ebrCount = 0;
        std::uint64_t ebrSumNs = 0;
        std::uint64_t ebrMaxNs = 0;
        std::uint64_t execCount = 0;
        std::uint64_t execSumNs = 0;
        std::uint64_t execMaxNs = 0;
        std::uint64_t unobservedSafe = 0;
        std::uint64_t rtRequests = 0;
        PathStats paths[kPathCount];
        // ★ 段階③: 3 分類（診断用の追加情報）
        ClassifiedPath classifiedPaths[kPathCount];
        ClassifiedTotals classTotals;
        std::vector<Observation> observations;
        std::vector<Observation> pending;   // 完了が観測できていない要求（先頭 8 件）
    };

    // 2 段階記録（Owner 条件）: 最終 drain 直前の状態を保持する
    struct StageStats
    {
        bool valid = false;
        std::uint64_t requests = 0;
        std::uint64_t completions = 0;
        std::uint64_t unmatchedCompletions = 0;
        std::uint64_t overflow = 0;
        std::uint64_t idExhausted = 0;
        std::uint64_t postShutdownRequests = 0;
        std::uint64_t postShutdownCompletions = 0; // ★ W-2
        std::uint64_t recordMisses = 0;   // ★ C5: 記録できなかった要求
        std::uint64_t pending = 0;
        std::uint64_t ebrCount = 0;
        std::uint64_t ebrSumNs = 0;
        std::uint64_t ebrMaxNs = 0;
        std::uint64_t execCount = 0;
        std::uint64_t execSumNs = 0;
        std::uint64_t execMaxNs = 0;
        std::uint64_t unobservedSafe = 0;
        std::uint64_t rtRequests = 0;
        PathStats paths[kPathCount];
    };

    void captureRuntimeStage() noexcept
    {
        StageStats s;
        s.valid = true;
        s.requests = requests_.load (std::memory_order_acquire);
        s.completions = completions_.load (std::memory_order_acquire);
        s.unmatchedCompletions = unmatchedCompletions_.load (std::memory_order_acquire);
        s.overflow = overflow_.load (std::memory_order_acquire);
        s.idExhausted = idExhausted_.load (std::memory_order_acquire);
        s.postShutdownRequests = postShutdown_.load (std::memory_order_acquire);
        s.postShutdownCompletions = postShutdownCompletions_.load (std::memory_order_acquire);
        s.recordMisses = recordMisses_.load (std::memory_order_acquire);
        s.ebrCount = ebrCount_.load (std::memory_order_acquire);
        s.ebrSumNs = ebrSumNs_.load (std::memory_order_acquire);
        s.ebrMaxNs = ebrMaxNs_.load (std::memory_order_acquire);
        s.execCount = execCount_.load (std::memory_order_acquire);
        s.execSumNs = execSumNs_.load (std::memory_order_acquire);
        s.execMaxNs = execMaxNs_.load (std::memory_order_acquire);
        s.unobservedSafe = unobservedSafe_.load (std::memory_order_acquire);
        s.rtRequests = rtRequests_.load (std::memory_order_acquire);
        s.pending = (s.requests > s.completions) ? (s.requests - s.completions) : 0;

        for (std::size_t p = 0; p < kPathCount; ++p)
        {
            s.paths[p].count = pathCount_[p].load (std::memory_order_acquire);
            s.paths[p].overThreshold = pathOver_[p].load (std::memory_order_acquire);
            s.paths[p].maxNs = pathMaxNs_[p].load (std::memory_order_acquire);
        }

        std::size_t slot = 0;
        const std::size_t current = runtimeStageSlot_.load (std::memory_order_acquire);
        slot = (current == 0u) ? 1u : 0u;
        runtimeStage_[slot] = s;
        runtimeStageSlot_.store (static_cast<std::size_t> (slot + 1u), std::memory_order_release);
    }

    // ★ W-2 (2026-11-10): 違反レポート生成時点（final 段）の累積値を保持する。
    //   postTeardown との差分を取るために使う。判定には使わない。
    void captureFinalStage() noexcept
    {
        const Snapshot s = snapshot();
        StageStats st;
        st.valid = true;
        st.requests = s.requests;
        st.completions = s.completions;
        st.unmatchedCompletions = s.unmatchedCompletions;
        st.overflow = s.overflow;
        st.idExhausted = s.idExhausted;
        st.postShutdownRequests = s.postShutdownRequests;
        st.postShutdownCompletions = s.postShutdownCompletions;
        st.recordMisses = s.recordMisses;
        st.pending = (s.requests > s.completions) ? (s.requests - s.completions) : 0;
        st.ebrCount = s.ebrCount;
        st.ebrSumNs = s.ebrSumNs;
        st.ebrMaxNs = s.ebrMaxNs;
        st.execCount = s.execCount;
        st.execSumNs = s.execSumNs;
        st.execMaxNs = s.execMaxNs;
        st.unobservedSafe = s.unobservedSafe;
        st.rtRequests = s.rtRequests;
        for (std::size_t p = 0; p < kPathCount; ++p)
            st.paths[p] = s.paths[p];

        finalStage_ = st;
        finalStageValid_.store (true, std::memory_order_release);
    }

    StageStats finalStage() const noexcept
    {
        return finalStage_;
    }

    StageStats runtimeStage() const noexcept
    {        const std::size_t marker = runtimeStageSlot_.load (std::memory_order_acquire);

        if (marker == 0u)
            return StageStats{};

        return runtimeStage_[(marker - 1u) == 0u ? 0u : 1u];
    }

    Snapshot snapshot() const
    {
        Snapshot s;
        s.requests = requests_.load (std::memory_order_acquire);
        s.completions = completions_.load (std::memory_order_acquire);
        s.unmatchedCompletions = unmatchedCompletions_.load (std::memory_order_acquire);
        s.overflow = overflow_.load (std::memory_order_acquire);
        s.idExhausted = idExhausted_.load (std::memory_order_acquire);
        s.cancelled = cancelled_.load (std::memory_order_acquire);
        s.postShutdownRequests = postShutdown_.load (std::memory_order_acquire);
        s.postShutdownCompletions = postShutdownCompletions_.load (std::memory_order_acquire);
        s.recordMisses = recordMisses_.load (std::memory_order_acquire);
        s.ebrCount = ebrCount_.load (std::memory_order_acquire);
        s.ebrSumNs = ebrSumNs_.load (std::memory_order_acquire);
        s.ebrMaxNs = ebrMaxNs_.load (std::memory_order_acquire);
        s.execCount = execCount_.load (std::memory_order_acquire);
        s.execSumNs = execSumNs_.load (std::memory_order_acquire);
        s.execMaxNs = execMaxNs_.load (std::memory_order_acquire);
        s.unobservedSafe = unobservedSafe_.load (std::memory_order_acquire);
        s.rtRequests = rtRequests_.load (std::memory_order_acquire);

        for (std::size_t p = 0; p < kPathCount; ++p)
        {
            s.paths[p].count = pathCount_[p].load (std::memory_order_acquire);
            s.paths[p].overThreshold = pathOver_[p].load (std::memory_order_acquire);
            s.paths[p].maxNs = pathMaxNs_[p].load (std::memory_order_acquire);
        }

        // 未完了の要求（診断用に先頭 8 件だけ）
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < kSlots && s.pending.size() < 8; ++i)
        {
            if (slots_[i].state.load (std::memory_order_acquire) != kStateReady)
                continue;

            Observation o;
            o.requestId = slots_[i].id.load (std::memory_order_relaxed);
            o.epoch = slots_[i].epoch.load (std::memory_order_relaxed);
            o.latencyNs = 0;
            o.path = 0xFFu;
            s.pending.push_back (o);
        }

        const std::uint64_t written = observationCount_.load (std::memory_order_acquire);
        const std::uint64_t limit = written < kObservationCapacity ? written : kObservationCapacity;

        for (std::uint64_t i = 0; i < limit; ++i)
        {
            const auto& o = observations_[i];

            if (o.path == 0xFFu)
                continue;

            s.observations.push_back (o);
        }

        // ★ 段階③: 3 分類のパス別集計（診断用の追加情報）
        for (std::size_t p = 0; p < kPathCount; ++p)
        {
            auto& cp = s.classifiedPaths[p];
            cp.driverWait.count = driverCount_[p].load (std::memory_order_acquire);
            cp.driverWait.sumNs = driverSumNs_[p].load (std::memory_order_acquire);
            cp.driverWait.maxNs = driverMaxNs_[p].load (std::memory_order_acquire);
            cp.driverWait.overThreshold = driverOver_[p].load (std::memory_order_acquire);
            cp.ebrWait.count = ebrCountC_[p].load (std::memory_order_acquire);
            cp.ebrWait.sumNs = ebrSumNsC_[p].load (std::memory_order_acquire);
            cp.ebrWait.maxNs = ebrMaxNsC_[p].load (std::memory_order_acquire);
            cp.ebrWait.overThreshold = ebrOverC_[p].load (std::memory_order_acquire);
            cp.execWait.count = execCountC_[p].load (std::memory_order_acquire);
            cp.execWait.sumNs = execSumNsC_[p].load (std::memory_order_acquire);
            cp.execWait.maxNs = execMaxNsC_[p].load (std::memory_order_acquire);
            cp.execWait.overThreshold = execOverC_[p].load (std::memory_order_acquire);
            cp.unclassifiedCount = classUnclassifiedCount_[p].load (std::memory_order_acquire);
            cp.unclassifiedSumNs = classUnclassifiedSumNs_[p].load (std::memory_order_acquire);
            cp.excludedCount = classExcluded_[p].load (std::memory_order_acquire);
        }

        s.classTotals.requests = s.requests;
        s.classTotals.completions = s.completions;
        s.classTotals.classified = classClassifiedTotal_.load (std::memory_order_acquire);
        s.classTotals.unclassified = classUnclassifiedTotal_.load (std::memory_order_acquire);
        s.classTotals.excluded = classExcludedTotal_.load (std::memory_order_acquire);
        s.classTotals.consistencyErrors = classConsistencyErrors_.load (std::memory_order_acquire);
        s.classTotals.pending = (s.requests > s.completions) ? (s.requests - s.completions) : 0;

        return s;
    }

    // 終了処理に入ったことを記録する（以後の要求は測定対象外）
    void markShutdownPhase() noexcept
    {
        captureRuntimeStage();   // ★ 最終 drain 直前の状態を保存する
        shutdownPhase_.store (true, std::memory_order_release);
    }

    void reset() noexcept
    {
        shutdownPhase_.store (false, std::memory_order_release);
        runtimeStage_[0] = StageStats{};
        runtimeStage_[1] = StageStats{};
        runtimeStageSlot_.store (0, std::memory_order_release);
        postShutdown_.store (0, std::memory_order_release);
        postShutdownCompletions_.store (0, std::memory_order_release);
        recordMisses_.store (0, std::memory_order_release);
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < kSlots; ++i)
        {
            slots_[i].state.store (kStateFree, std::memory_order_release);
            slots_[i].object.store (nullptr, std::memory_order_relaxed);
            slots_[i].id.store (0, std::memory_order_relaxed);
            slots_[i].tsNs.store (0, std::memory_order_relaxed);
            slots_[i].epoch.store (0, std::memory_order_relaxed);
        }

        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < kObservationCapacity; ++i)
            observations_[i] = Observation{0, 0, 0, 0xFFu};

        requests_.store (0, std::memory_order_release);
        completions_.store (0, std::memory_order_release);
        unmatchedCompletions_.store (0, std::memory_order_release);
        overflow_.store (0, std::memory_order_release);
        idExhausted_.store (0, std::memory_order_release);
        cancelled_.store (0, std::memory_order_release);
        observationCount_.store (0, std::memory_order_release);
        nextId_.store (0, std::memory_order_release);
        nextRange_.store (0, std::memory_order_release);
        ebrCount_.store (0, std::memory_order_release);
        ebrSumNs_.store (0, std::memory_order_release);
        ebrMaxNs_.store (0, std::memory_order_release);
        execCount_.store (0, std::memory_order_release);
        execSumNs_.store (0, std::memory_order_release);
        execMaxNs_.store (0, std::memory_order_release);
        unobservedSafe_.store (0, std::memory_order_release);
        rtRequests_.store (0, std::memory_order_release);

        for (std::size_t p = 0; p < kPathCount; ++p)
        {
            pathCount_[p].store (0, std::memory_order_release);
            pathOver_[p].store (0, std::memory_order_release);
            pathMaxNs_[p].store (0, std::memory_order_release);
            driverCount_[p].store (0, std::memory_order_release);
            driverSumNs_[p].store (0, std::memory_order_release);
            driverMaxNs_[p].store (0, std::memory_order_release);
            driverOver_[p].store (0, std::memory_order_release);
            ebrCountC_[p].store (0, std::memory_order_release);
            ebrSumNsC_[p].store (0, std::memory_order_release);
            ebrMaxNsC_[p].store (0, std::memory_order_release);
            ebrOverC_[p].store (0, std::memory_order_release);
            execCountC_[p].store (0, std::memory_order_release);
            execSumNsC_[p].store (0, std::memory_order_release);
            execMaxNsC_[p].store (0, std::memory_order_release);
            execOverC_[p].store (0, std::memory_order_release);
            classUnclassifiedCount_[p].store (0, std::memory_order_release);
            classUnclassifiedSumNs_[p].store (0, std::memory_order_release);
            classExcluded_[p].store (0, std::memory_order_release);
        }
        classClassifiedTotal_.store (0, std::memory_order_release);
        classUnclassifiedTotal_.store (0, std::memory_order_release);
        classUnclassifiedSumTotal_.store (0, std::memory_order_release);
        classExcludedTotal_.store (0, std::memory_order_release);
        classConsistencyErrors_.store (0, std::memory_order_release);
    }

private:
    static constexpr std::uint8_t kStateFree = 0;
    static constexpr std::uint8_t kStateFilling = 1;
    static constexpr std::uint8_t kStateReady = 2;

    struct Slot
    {
        std::atomic<std::uint8_t> state{kStateFree};
        std::atomic<const void*> object{nullptr};
        std::atomic<std::uint64_t> id{0};
        std::atomic<std::uint64_t> tsNs{0};        // enqueueTs
        std::atomic<std::uint64_t> safeTsNs{0};    // 0 = 未観測（強制解放など）
        std::atomic<std::uint64_t> epoch{0};       // enqueueEpoch
        std::atomic<std::uint64_t> minReaderEpoch{0};
        std::atomic<std::uint32_t> minReaderSlot{0xFFFFFFFFu};
    };

    RetireLatencyRecorder() { reset(); }

    static std::uint64_t nowNs() noexcept
    {
        using namespace std::chrono;
        return static_cast<std::uint64_t> (
            duration_cast<nanoseconds> (steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch()).count());
    }

    std::uint32_t rangeForCurrentThread() noexcept
    {
        thread_local std::uint32_t assigned = 0xFFFFFFFFu;

        if (assigned == 0xFFFFFFFFu)
            assigned = nextRange_.fetch_add (1u, std::memory_order_relaxed)
                       % static_cast<std::uint32_t> (kRanges);

        return assigned;
    }

    static void addCount (std::atomic<std::uint64_t>& counter) noexcept
    {
        counter.fetch_add (1u, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
    }

    // object に対応する ready スロットを 1 つだけ確保する（CAS で二重取得を防ぐ）。
    bool claim (const void* object, std::size_t& index) noexcept
    {
        if (object == nullptr)
            return false;

        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < kSlots; ++i)
        {
            if (slots_[i].state.load (std::memory_order_acquire) != kStateReady)
                continue;

            if (slots_[i].object.load (std::memory_order_acquire) != object)
                continue;

            std::uint8_t expected = kStateReady;

            if (slots_[i].state.compare_exchange_strong (expected, kStateFilling,
                                                         std::memory_order_acq_rel,
                                                         std::memory_order_acquire))
            {
                index = i;
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    // ★ 段階③: 1 成分（driver/ebr/exec）の集計
    static void accumulateComponent (std::atomic<std::uint64_t>& count,
                                     std::atomic<std::uint64_t>& sumNs,
                                     std::atomic<std::uint64_t>& maxNs,
                                     std::atomic<std::uint64_t>& overThreshold,
                                     std::uint64_t value) noexcept
    {
        count.fetch_add (1u, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
        sumNs.fetch_add (value, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
        if (value > kThresholdNs)
            overThreshold.fetch_add (1u, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
        updateMax (maxNs, value);
    }
    void accumulateUnclassified (std::size_t pathIndex, std::uint64_t value) noexcept
    {
        classUnclassifiedTotal_.fetch_add (1u, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
        classUnclassifiedSumTotal_.fetch_add (value, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
        if (pathIndex < kPathCount)
        {
            classUnclassifiedCount_[pathIndex].fetch_add (1u, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
            classUnclassifiedSumNs_[pathIndex].fetch_add (value, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
        }
    }
    static void updateMax (std::atomic<std::uint64_t>& target, std::uint64_t value) noexcept
    {
        std::uint64_t current = target.load (std::memory_order_acquire);

        while (value > current
               && ! target.compare_exchange_weak (current, value,
                                                  std::memory_order_acq_rel,
                                                  std::memory_order_acquire))
        {
        }
    }

    void accumulatePath (Path path, std::uint64_t latency) noexcept
    {
        const std::size_t p = static_cast<std::size_t> (path);

        if (p >= kPathCount)
            return;

        pathCount_[p].fetch_add (1u, std::memory_order_acq_rel);

        if (latency > kThresholdNs)
            pathOver_[p].fetch_add (1u, std::memory_order_acq_rel);

        std::uint64_t current = pathMaxNs_[p].load (std::memory_order_acquire);

        while (latency > current
               && ! pathMaxNs_[p].compare_exchange_weak (current, latency,
                                                         std::memory_order_acq_rel,
                                                         std::memory_order_acquire))
        {
        }
    }

    void appendObservation (std::uint64_t id, std::uint64_t epoch,
                            std::uint64_t latency, Path path,
                            std::uint64_t enqueueTs, std::uint64_t safeTs,
                            std::uint64_t minReaderEpoch, std::uint32_t minReaderSlot,
                            std::uint64_t firstScanTs = 0,
                            Classification cls = Classification{}) noexcept
    {
        const std::uint64_t index = observationCount_.fetch_add (1u, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
        Observation o;
        o.requestId = id;
        o.epoch = epoch;
        o.latencyNs = latency;
        o.path = static_cast<std::uint8_t> (path);
        o.enqueueTsNs = enqueueTs;
        o.safeTsNs = safeTs;
        o.minReaderEpoch = minReaderEpoch;
        o.minReaderSlot = minReaderSlot;
        // ★ 段階③: 3 分類の値（診断用。既存フィールドは不変）
        o.firstScanTsNs = firstScanTs;
        o.driverWaitNs = cls.driverWaitNs;
        o.ebrWaitNs = cls.ebrWaitNs;
        o.execWaitNs = cls.execWaitNs;
        o.unclassifiedNs = cls.unclassifiedNs;
        o.classified = (cls.classified ? 1u : 0u);
        observations_[index % kObservationCapacity] = o;
    }

    Slot slots_[kSlots];
    Observation observations_[kObservationCapacity];

    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> nextId_{0};
    std::atomic<std::uint32_t> nextRange_{0};
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> requests_{0};
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> completions_{0};
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> unmatchedCompletions_{0};
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> overflow_{0};
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> idExhausted_{0};
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> cancelled_{0};
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> postShutdown_{0};
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> postShutdownCompletions_{0};   // ★ W-2
    // ★ C5 (2026-11-10): 記録できなかった要求の総数（overflow・ID 枯渇・shutdown 相）
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> recordMisses_{0};
    std::atomic<bool> shutdownPhase_{false};
    StageStats runtimeStage_[2]{};
    std::atomic<std::size_t> runtimeStageSlot_{0};
    // ★ W-2: final 段（違反レポート生成時点）
    StageStats finalStage_{};
    std::atomic<bool> finalStageValid_{false};
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> observationCount_{0};
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> ebrCount_{0};
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> ebrSumNs_{0};
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> ebrMaxNs_{0};
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> execCount_{0};
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> execSumNs_{0};
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> execMaxNs_{0};
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> unobservedSafe_{0};
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> rtRequests_{0};
    // ★ 段階③: 3 分類のパス別集計（診断用・判定には使わない）
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> driverCount_[kPathCount];
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> driverSumNs_[kPathCount];
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> driverMaxNs_[kPathCount];
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> driverOver_[kPathCount];
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> ebrCountC_[kPathCount];
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> ebrSumNsC_[kPathCount];
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> ebrMaxNsC_[kPathCount];
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> ebrOverC_[kPathCount];
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> execCountC_[kPathCount];
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> execSumNsC_[kPathCount];
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> execMaxNsC_[kPathCount];
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> execOverC_[kPathCount];
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> classUnclassifiedCount_[kPathCount];
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> classUnclassifiedSumNs_[kPathCount];
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> classExcluded_[kPathCount];
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> classClassifiedTotal_{0};
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> classUnclassifiedTotal_{0};
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> classUnclassifiedSumTotal_{0};
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> classExcludedTotal_{0};
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> classConsistencyErrors_{0};
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> pathCount_[kPathCount];
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> pathOver_[kPathCount];
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> pathMaxNs_[kPathCount];
};

} // namespace isr
} // namespace convo
```
